summary: Digibuzzer provides a virtual game room interface centered around a connected buzzer system. As the documentation is currently written only in French, users may need to translate configuration guides to set up and host online quiz or game sessions.
goodFor: It suits technical hosts running small, interactive group sessions who are comfortable reading French documentation or figuring out basic Node.js deployments.
watchOut: The repository currently has no tagged releases and zero recorded recent commits, indicating that development activity is practically non-existent and ongoing maintenance will fall entirely on you under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
deployNotes: Being built with Node.js, it typically requires a persistent process manager like PM2 or a container runtime, alongside a reverse proxy such as Nginx to handle TLS termination.
